Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to create a starter account, so that a starter has a directory identity.
Requirement: BR-01. Fictional office; scope: Approval simulated.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an approved starter request
When the analyst creates a Staff user
Then the user exists in the Staff OU.

Summary: US-02: Reset password and require change
Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to reset password and require change, so that temporary passwords must be replaced.
Requirement: BR-01. Fictional office; scope: Flag verified; no Windows login.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an existing test account
When its password is reset
Then change at next logon is required.

Summary: US-03: Lock after five failed sign-ins
Description:
As a security owner, I want to lock after five failed sign-ins, so that password guessing is limited.
Requirement: BR-01. Fictional office; scope: LDAP test.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a valid test account
When five bad LDAP binds occur
Then lockoutTime is set.

Summary: US-04: Reject correct password while locked
Description:
As a security owner, I want to reject correct password while locked, so that lockout is enforced.
Requirement: BR-01. Fictional office; scope: LDAP test.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a locked test account
When the correct password is used
Then authentication is denied.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to unlock and authenticate, so that authorised staff can recover access.
Requirement: BR-01. Fictional office; scope: Approval simulated.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a locked test account
When the analyst unlocks it
Then authenticated LDAP search succeeds.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to assign directory finance membership, so that directory role membership is recorded.
Requirement: BR-01. Fictional office; scope: Does not grant standalone SMB.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an approved Finance starter
When GG-Finance is assigned
Then the user appears in that group.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to disable a directory leaver, so that directory access ends at departure.
Requirement: BR-02. Fictional office; scope: SMB/VPN separate.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an approved leaver request
When the account is disabled
Then the disable flag is set.

Description:
As a security owner, I want to reject disabled account sign-in, so that leaver revocation is checked.
Requirement: BR-02. Fictional office; scope: LDAP test.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a disabled account
When an LDAP sign-in is attempted
Then authentication is denied.

Summary: US-09: Write and read Finance files
Description:
As a Finance employee, I want to write and read finance files, so that Finance documents can be shared.
Requirement: BR-03. Fictional office; scope: Standalone Samba.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Alice has finance membership
When she writes and reads a file
Then content is verified.

Summary: US-10: Deny Finance to non-Finance staff
Description:
As a Finance manager, I want to deny finance to non-finance staff, so that confidential files remain restricted.
Requirement: BR-03. Fictional office; scope: Standalone Samba.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Bob belongs to staff
When he opens Finance
Then access is denied.

Summary: US-11: Use Public as Finance staff
Description:
As a Finance employee, I want to use public as finance staff, so that Finance can collaborate across teams.
Requirement: BR-03. Fictional office; scope: Standalone Samba.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Alice is authenticated
When she writes and reads Public
Then both operations succeed.

Summary: US-12: Use Public as general staff
Description:
As a office employee, I want to use public as general staff, so that general staff can collaborate.
Requirement: BR-03. Fictional office; scope: Standalone Samba.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Bob is authenticated
When he writes and reads Public
Then both operations succeed.

Summary: US-13: Complete a PDF print job
Description:
As a office employee, I want to complete a pdf print job, so that printed PDF output can be retrieved.
Requirement: BR-04. Fictional office; scope: PDF output only.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Office-PDF is enabled
When a test page is submitted
Then IPP job-state is 9 and a PDF exists.

Summary: US-14: View queues without admin access
Description:
As a office employee, I want to view queues without admin access, so that staff can check waiting jobs.
Requirement: BR-04. Fictional office; scope: HTTP response.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given CUPS is running
When I request /printers
Then HTTP 200 is returned.

Description:
As a security owner, I want to require admin authentication, so that anonymous users cannot change queues.
Requirement: BR-04. Fictional office; scope: Local lab admin.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an anonymous client
When it requests /admin/
Then HTTP 401 is returned.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to allow authenticated printer admin, so that authorised operators can manage queues.
Requirement: BR-04. Fictional office; scope: Local lab admin.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the print administrator credentials
When the admin page is requested
Then HTTP 200 is returned.

Summary: US-17: Create and list a device peer
Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to create and list a device peer, so that each device has individual access.
Requirement: BR-05. Fictional office; scope: Profile delivery untested.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a test device request
When a peer is created
Then the peer appears with an address.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to revoke a device peer, so that revoked profiles are removed.
Requirement: BR-02. Fictional office; scope: No lost-device incident claimed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a temporary peer exists
When the peer is deleted
Then it is absent from the next list.

Summary: US-19: Restore office route through VPN
Description:
As a remote employee, I want to restore office route through vpn, so that remote staff can reach office files.
Requirement: BR-05. Fictional office; scope: Isolated Docker peer.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a handshake but missing office route
When AllowedIPs includes 172.20.0.0/16 and the tunnel restarts
Then route uses wg0 and Public listing succeeds.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to repair starter finance access, so that approved starters can access Finance without widening permissions.
Requirement: BR-03. Fictional office; scope: Approval simulated; transient test.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Public works but Finance denies a starter
When finance membership is added and identity refreshed
Then Finance write read and delete succeed.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to recover paused queues, so that waiting jobs resume after maintenance.
Requirement: BR-04. Fictional office; scope: Laser output untested.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given both queues paused and a PDF job waiting
When queues are enabled and accept jobs
Then original job completes at state 9.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to respond on monitoring console, so that operators can inspect service availability.
Requirement: BR-06. Fictional office; scope: Response only.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Kuma is running
When the local console is requested
Then HTTP 200 is returned.

Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to show six monitors up, so that operators can identify unavailable services.
Requirement: BR-06. Fictional office; scope: Point in time; no SLA.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the six office monitors exist
When the status heartbeat is checked
Then all six latest heartbeats are UP.

Description:
As a office employee, I want to open office dashboard, so that office links are available from one place.
Requirement: BR-06. Fictional office; scope: Usability untested.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Homepage is running
When the local dashboard is requested
Then HTTP 200 is returned.

Summary: US-25: Clean up temporary test accounts
Description:
As a service desk analyst, I want to clean up temporary test accounts, so that test access is not retained.
Requirement: BR-07. Fictional office; scope: AD cleanup.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the directory exercise is complete
When cleanup runs
Then the temporary account is removed.
